singleton_scope.protected_decision: Whether the current A-short steady 5d CSI1000 clue is candidate alpha, risk-filter-only, or falsified after same-anchor re-audit.
applies_to: A-short steady 24-month production Tier1 evidence review.
The frozen same-anchor 5d / 20d CSI1000 / CSI300 re-audit defined in research/preregistrations/a_short_steady_alpha_reaudit_20260603.json.
does_not_authorize: No outcome run before independent review and explicit user execute command.
No EGS rerun, no new data fetch, no provider call, no DataHub work, no runner change, no production rule change, no ship-gate claim, and no full-size manual use.

creation_reason.reason: The current 5d CSI1000 signal is the only notable A-short steady positive clue and is suspected to be a measurement-basis artifact. A planned-test ledger prevents silent reruns, parameter rescue, benchmark sweeps, or post-result threshold changes.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first same-anchor outcome run spends one planned test regardless of pass, risk-filter-only, or fail result.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: If the result fails or becomes risk-filter-only, do not rerun with changed horizons, thresholds, universe, ranking cap, benchmark, cost model, or veto set without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.

planned_tests.design_summary: One frozen same-anchor A-short steady re-audit: 5d / 20d net benchmark excess, CSI1000 primary, CSI300 secondary, production Tier1 v7.10 24-month cohort surface, with multiple-testing, slice, factor, veto, and PIT checks.
review_boundary: Claude review must pass before any outcome run.
The user must issue a later execute command after review before any outcome run.
Run must use existing local evidence only and must not fetch data, rerun EGS, regenerate cohorts, alter parameters, or write production outputs.

next_required_actions: Review the preregistration and this ledger together.
If review passes and the user later executes the outcome slice, update this planned test to spent with the research-only evidence report path.
Keep any result out of production and ship-gate evidence unless a later reviewed forward-live process satisfies the fixed ship-gate.
